title: dryopteris longipes
intro: Dryopteris longipes, commonly known as the Himalayan Shield Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris longipes include its anti-inflammatory, anticoagulant, and anti-diabetic properties, which may help to prevent the formation of blood clots and regulate blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
